Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D boxing game animation atlas for player.
Input image 1 is the exact character IDENTITY reference. Input image 2 is the existing WALK ATLAS and is the STYLE, proportions, scale and guard-pose reference; do not copy its walking action. Preserve this fighter's exact face/head, hair, skin tone, clothing, logos/markings/accessories, red gloves, dark outlines and flat cartoon shading. Never substitute a generic boxer.
ONE square PNG with genuine transparent background. Strict invisible 2 by 2 grid, four equal square cells, row-major; every pose completely inside its cell, at least 6% empty margin. Suggested 1024x1024, cells512. Neutral visible body height384 percell (75% ofcell), common ground baseline y480 (94% ofcell), common standing foot-center x256. Same body and head dimensions across all frames; no independent pose zoom. Every frame has coherent two arms, two red gloved hands, two legs and two shoes. Full head and feet, never clipped. Characters face RIGHT except natural orientation while falling. Four-frame subtle breathing idle loop. ALL four cells show the SAME boxing guard stance with feet planted in exactly the same positions, knees slightly flexed, gloves near chest/chin. Cell 1 neutral, cell 2 tiny inhale, cell 3 peak inhale, cell 4 exhale. No walking, jumping, waving, or open starfish arms. Chest/head motion at most 1% of body height. Keep skull, hair, clothing and facial features IDENTICAL.
No background, floor, shadows, grid lines, numbers, captions, extra characters, UI, watermarks or decorative effects. Clean alpha transparency, including empty unused cells.
